source.time_basis: source-naive hourly timestamps; metadata timezone retained separately
source.measurement: electricity kWh, as used by existing BDG2 contracts
source.license_status: not re-verified in local metadata by this TRAIN-only receipt

unit_contract.exposure_scope: No forecast-performance use found in bounded local records for selected Peacock education IDs; metadata and TRAIN quality reviewed. Backbone overlap and complete historic non-use not established.

bootstrap.scope: Conditional on the two selected seeds; parent/model/LR selection uncertainty is not included

peacock_education.aggregation: Pool period channel SSE/count; macro across channels; then mean seed losses

interpretation.accuracy: Mean of individual seed losses; not averaged predictions
interpretation.seed_reference: Individual trained seeds use the corresponding reference seed; aggregate rows use mean losses; F0 has one frozen reference
interpretation.q_references: Same selected A checkpoint; no independently optimized no-Q claim
interpretation.timing: This campaign only; every prescribed execution retained; no automatic Pareto or stable superiority claim
interpretation.cpu: Direct CPU is a separate practical deployment path; GPU memory unavailable rather than zero
interpretation.scope: One building-electricity group where applicable; no claim of cross-domain confirmation
interpretation.uncertainty: Seed/block ranges are descriptive; bootstrap intervals retain the evaluation source limitations
